newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet has FIM 500 mln paper machine order.
newsitem.headline: Valmet has FIM 500 mln paper machine order.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Thursday that it will deliver a fine paper machine to a mill in China owned by a Hong Kong unit of the Singapore-based April Group.
"Valmet will deliver a large fine paper machine, worth approximately 500 million markka, to Changsu near Shanghai in China," it said.
"The Changsu (machine) will be one of the largest paper machines in China and in the whole of Asia," Valmet said, but did not give the capacity of the machine.
The customer is Norscan-Tech Ltd from Hong Kong, Valmet said, adding the order will strengthen its position in Asia as a supplier of large paper machines.
